{{Quote|Lachichuk suggests we continue this conversation in Kachirho.|Cudgel, to Olee Starstone, in the aftermath of the Battle of Kashyyyk|<ref name="Dark Lord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
'''Lachichuk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warrior and a famed [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Merumeru/Legends|Merumeru]] in a [[Merumeru's volunteer soldiers|volunteer army]] during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] in the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When a [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] belonging to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] attacked the coastal [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], Lachichuk, Merumeru, and dozens of other Wookiees fought on the [[Beach/Legends|beachfront]] alongside [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in an effort to resist the assault. After a fierce battle, the Confederate force surrendered, and the war itself [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|ended]] shortly thereafter.

At the conclusion of the war, all Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were shut down, and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] declared all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] enemies of the state and had them [[Order 66/Legends|executed]]. The Republic [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] departed Kashyyyk, and Lachichuk joined in a massive Wookiee effort to clean up the battleground and salvage leftover machinery. Several days later, Lachichuk and three other Wookiees were alerted by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] liaison [[Cudgel (Human)|Cudgel]] that several [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] had arrived onworld seeking knowledge about Jedi. The Wookiees interrogated the newcomers at [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasterpoint]] until they learned that the traders were Jedi on the run; at that point Lachichuk and the others brought the fugitives to see the Wookiee [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] and his comrade [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].

==Biography==
===Defending Kachirho===
{{Quote|The droids have started up their main power generators.''"<br />"''Then now, the time is, Commander.|[[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] and Jedi Master Yoda, immediately prior to the Battle of Kashyyyk, in which Lachichuk fought|<ref name="Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
[[File:Wookiee_trench.png|thumb|left|350px|Merumeru leads Lachichuk and dozens of other Wookiees into battle.]]
Lachichuk was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warrior<ref name="Force Collection" /> who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he had gained fame across the world as a [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]].<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] began to land their [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid armies]] on Kashyyyk in 19 BBY<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> in a bid to secure secret [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]] from a [[Claatuvac Guild/Legends|guild]] of [[Navigator/Legends|navigators]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]]<ref name="The Hidden Enemy">[[Republic 81|''Republic'' 81]]</ref> and to subjugate the entire planet. An invasion force prepared to [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|attack]] Kachirho, and, when word spread of the impending battle, Wookiees from across the world rushed to the coastal city to aid in its defense.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> Lachichuk volunteered to serve as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Merumeru/Legends|Merumeru]], who was preparing to lead [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground resistance]] from the city's [[Beach/Legends|beachfront]].<ref name="DB" />

When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;the Confederacy's opponent in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] war&mdash;learned of Kachirho's plight, it sent four [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]]<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" /><ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /><ref name="Tsui Choi">{{SW|url=thread.jspa?messageID=17078201|text=StarWars Forums: Holocron continuity database questions|nobackup=1}}</ref> and an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to fight alongside the Wookiees. As defensive positions were established on the shoreline, Merumeru's [[Merumeru's volunteer soldiers|army]] of volunteer warriors stationed themselves behind [[Armor/Legends|armored]] revetments that overlooked the [[Water/Legends|water]]. When the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] army, which was crossing Kachirho's lagoon in assault vehicles, neared its target, Lachichuk and the rest of Merumeru's army emerged from their hiding place and rushed at the invaders with weapons in [[Limb/Legends|hand]]. Along with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], they fought on foot during the battle.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" /> After a fierce skirmish, the Republic and Wookiee forces gained enough of an edge to force the Confederate army to surrender.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy 2">[[Republic 82|''Republic'' 82]]</ref>

===Battle's aftermath===
{{Quote|For a while it looked like Kashyyyk was going to have its own garrison of clone troopers, but after the Sep droids and war machines shut down, the troopers decamped. Ever since, the Wookiees have been making good use of everything that was left behind.|Cudgel, speaking of the battle's aftermath and the roles of Wookiees such as Lachichuk in it|<ref name="Dark Lord" />}}
Shortly after the battle's end, all members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were declared enemies of the Republic by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and clone troopers across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] [[Order 66/Legends|attacked]] their [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]]. Many Jedi,<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" /> including Master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] on Kashyyyk,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy 2" /> were [[Death/Legends|killed]] as part of the Chancellor's ploy to [[Declaration of a New Order|seize]] unchallenged control of the Republic; his scheme also included having the Confederacy's [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|murdered]] and the war brought to an end. All Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were shut down,<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" /> which prompted the Republic forces to depart Kashyyyk. Lachichuk and the other Wookiees began to clean up the site of the battle and salvage the leftover machinery.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

[[File:Lachichukandguanta.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Lachichuk and fellow warrior [[Guanta/Legends|Guanta]]]]
Days after the battle, Lachichuk was at a busy landing platform outside of Kachirho where a variety of business deals and trades were taking place. [[Cudgel (Human)|Cudgel]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] liaison who could understand the Wookiees' [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] [[Language/Legends|language]], approached Lachichuk, the [[Gender/Legends|male]] Wookiee [[Guania]], and two other Wookiees to inform them that a newly-arrived group of [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] were asking questions about Jedi. The four of them followed Cudgel to the traders' [[Vagabond Trader|ship]] and brandished their [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]], demanding to know the newcomers' interest in Jedi. [[Olee Starstone]], one of the traders, stated that they were themselves Jedi on the run, but her defiant companion [[Siadem Forte]] contradicted her. Starstone then mentioned her knowledge of the Jedi [[General/Legends|Generals]] who had fought in the recent battle and pleaded with the Wookiees to help her crew locate them. The sympathetic Wookiees responded by disabling their weapons, and Lachichuk suggested to Cudgel that they relocate to a private place in Kachirho.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

The Wookiees and Cudgel then led Starstone and her companions to a giant [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr tree]] that stood in the center of the city, and they rode a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] up the [[Tree/Legends|tree]] to a central control room where the Wookiees [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and General [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] were working. The two were friends of the Jedi and had even helped Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] flee the planet; Lachichuk briefed the two on the situation, and they in turn informed Starstone that none of the surviving Jedi Generals had remained on Kashyyyk. Starstone was keen to leave and continue her search for more scattered Jedi, but Tarfful offered her and her crew safe haven on Kashyyyk. A chime from one of the control room's consoles interrupted the conversation at that moment, and the room's occupants learned that forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;a new government that had succeeded the Republic at the conclusion of the war&mdash;were making planetfall, as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] Palpatine had earlier learned that Jedi were en route to Kashyyyk. Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] back at the landing platform demanded that the fugitives be turned over to them, and a resulting brawl escalated into a full-scale [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|battle]] that the Empire quickly won. Thousands of Wookiees were rounded up to be used as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in Imperial construction projects.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|They're interested in knowing why you're so interested in knowing whether any Jedi were here during the battle.|Cudgel, to Olee Starstone, speaking of Lachichuk and three other Wookiees|<ref name="Dark Lord" />}}
Lachichuk was a famed hunter<ref name="Chronicles" /> and a capable warrior<ref name="DB" /> who volunteered to serve under Captain Merumeru in the Battle of Kashyyyk. Loyally fighting under Merumeru's leadership,<ref name="Chronicles" /> Lachichuk survived the battle.<ref name="Dark Lord" /> He had dark [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin,<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="World of Star Wars" /> and brown [[Hair/Legends|fur]] that was streaked with black,<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" /> as well as sharp [[Tooth/Legends|fangs]] that could puncture durable [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] skin.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> Lachichuk was right-handed,<ref name="Obsessed With Star Wars">''[[Obsessed With Star Wars]]''</ref> could speak Shyriiwook, and could understand [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Like other Wookiees who fought alongside Jedi during the battle, Lachichuk was sympathetic to surviving members of the Jedi Order during the early days of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Lachichuk was suspicious when Olee Starstone arrived on Kashyyyk and began to ask questions about the Jedi, but when it was revealed that Starstone was herself a Jedi, Lachichuk relaxed and suggested that she and her comrades be brought to see Tarfful, a war [[Chief/Legends|chief]] of Kachirho who had helped Jedi Master Yoda flee the planet.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Wookiee costumes were the single biggest task for the Episode III Creature Department. As the production was based in Sydney, all the Wookiee extras were found locally, and they included basketball players and a prison security guard. These performers were fitted with sculpted muscle suits covered in stretchy material knitted with modacrylic hair.|''Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels''|<ref name="Chronicles" />}}
[[File:Wookiees-Transparent.png|thumb|left|250px|A promotional shot of Merumeru, Lachichuk, and Guanta]]
The character of Lachichuk was created for use in [[George Lucas]]'s [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which features a large number of Wookiees participating in the Battle of Kashyyyk.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" /> Lachichuk's Wookiee costume was constructed by [[Industrial Light & Magic]]'s creature department<ref name="The Wookiees Are Back">{{SW|url=video/the-wookiees-are-back|series=Making Episode III Webdocs|text=The Wookiees Are Back!}}</ref> and was one of eight that were built and photographed for the film.<ref name="DB Wookiee">{{DB|species|wookiee|Wookiee}}</ref> In [[Wikipedia:Sydney|Sydney]], [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australia]], local [[Wikipedia:Extra (actor)|extras]], including several basketball players and a corrections officer, were recruited to play Wookiees in ''Revenge of the Sith''<ref name="Chronicles" />&mdash;save for Chewbacca, who was portrayed by actor [[Peter Mayhew]], the film's credits do not state which actors played which Wookiees,<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" /> but other official sources have connected four of the extras to their respective roles. Lachichuk is not one of those roles, but process of elimination reveals that Lachichuk was played by either [[Steven Foy]], [[James Rowland]], or [[Julian Khazzouh]].<ref name="DB" /><ref name="The Wookiees Are Back" /><ref name="DB2">{{DB|character|salporin|Salporin}}</ref><ref name="Making of ROTS">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Each Wookiee extra had a full body and head cast made for use in a fitted [[Wikipedia:Glass-reinforced plastic|fiberglass]] muscle suit<ref name="The Wookiees Are Back" /> that was then covered in an elastic material knitted with [[Wikipedia:Modacrylic|modacrylic]] hair.<ref name="Chronicles" />

''Revenge of the Sith''{{'s}} Kashyyyk scenes were filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney|Fox Studios]] in Sydney on [[May 17]] and [[May 18]], [[2004]],<ref name="Making of ROTS" /> after principal photography for the film had already been completed. Lachichuk's scenes were directed by Animation Supervisor [[Rob Coleman]],<ref name="Chronicles" /> who had Lachichuk and four other Wookiee characters repeatedly rush over a barrier with a [[Wikipedia:Chroma key|bluescreen]] behind them. Each time the scene was filmed, the Wookiees took new positions and carried different weapons and accessories. The shots were then digitally combined to fill out the front row of the Wookiee army,<ref name="The Wookiees Are Back" /> and the Wookiees were afterward digitally duplicated so as to present dozens of additional warriors standing behind them and participating in the beachfront battle.<ref name="DB Wookiee" />

Lachichuk also appears briefly in [[James Luceno]]'s 2005 novel ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'',<ref name="Dark Lord" /> and is additionally discussed in several sourcebooks, most of which are directly related to ''Revenge of the Sith''. He was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was released a month prior to the film.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /><ref name="Chronicles" /><ref name="Making of ROTS" /><ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|240|Lachichuk}}</ref> Several of these sources include a photo from ''Revenge of the Sith'' of Merumeru leading Wookiees into battle;<ref name="Illustrated Screenplay">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref><ref name="Photcomic">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Cine-Manga|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' Cine-Manga]]</ref> although many of the Wookiees in the photo are digital duplicates of Lachichuk,<ref name="DB Wookiee" /> an image caption in ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'' explicitly states that Lachichuk is present in the frame.<ref name="Chronicles" />

An action figure called "Wookiee Warrior" that uses Lachichuk's likeness and that was packaged with a photo of Lachichuk was released as part of the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' toy line]] in 2005.<ref name="action figure">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|pack=#43: Wookiee Warrior (Wookiee Battle Bash!)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/ROTS0543wookiee.asp}}</ref> A second "Wookiee Warrior" figure is a repainted model of the first and was packaged with the same photo of Lachichuk; the figure is a Wookiee with light-tan fur, however, and thus represents a separate character.<ref name="Impostor 1">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|pack=#43: Wookiee Warrior (Wookiee Battle Bash!) (second version)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/ROTS0543wookiee2.asp}}</ref> A third figure, this one called "Wookiee [[Commando/Legends|Commando]]," is yet another repainted model of Lachichuk's figure, and was packaged with the same photo, this time digitally darkened to represent a black- and gray-furred Wookiee.<ref name="Impostor 2">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|pack=#58: Wookiee Commando|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/ROTS0558wookiee.asp}}</ref>
